title: Create test_e2e_plastic.py
objective: Create the J2 plasticity end-to-end Taichi execution test. Compile J2 ProblemIR, import generated module, run Newton with external BC enforcement and alpha save/restore, apply uniaxial tension past yield, verify hardening response.
implementation_steps: Create test_e2e_plastic.py following test_e2e_taichi.py elastic structure
Construct J2 ProblemIR (sigma_y0=200, K=100, n=0.3, E=200e3, nu=0.3)
compile(problem_ir) → emitted source, write to tmp_path, import module
Implement _newton_with_bc_plastic() with alpha save/restore per plan pattern
Load stepping: incremental displacement past yield in N steps
Assert (a) below yield → elastic match, (b) above yield → hardening law, (c) return mapping residual ≈ 0
acceptance_criteria: Generated J2 code compiles under Taichi JIT without error
Below yield: stress matches elastic reference (within FD tolerance)
Above yield: stress follows σ_y0 + K·ε_p^n
Return mapping: f(σ^{n+1}) ≈ 0 to machine precision

cases: J2 code compiles under Taichi JIT

risks: Risk: alpha save/restore during Newton iterations may be incorrect, producing wrong stress state. Mitigation: follow exact pattern from plan (lines 337-348), verify alpha_snapshot before/after each iteration.
Risk: FD tangent corrupts alpha during perturbation. Mitigation: save/restore alpha around tangent_matvec calls too.
Risk: Newton may not converge for plastic problem with FD tangent. Mitigation: accept looser tol (1e-6) and more iterations (50) for plastic case.
completion_notes: All 5 E2E tests pass: JIT compile, below-yield elastic, above-yield hardening, return mapping, load stepping
Fixed Taichi 1.7.4 tuple annotation incompatibility in constitutive_update_plastic emission
Alpha save/restore pattern verified working: snapshot before Newton loop, restore before each residual eval
CG breakdown warning at step 1 is pre-existing and benign
